name: XlCellChangedState
description: Specifies whether a PivotTable value cell has been edited or recalculated since the PivotTable report was created or the last commit operation was performed.

constants.name: xlCellNotChanged
constants.description: The value in the cell has not been edited or recalculated.

constants.name: xlCellChanged
constants.description: The value in the cell has been edited or recalculated.

constants.name: xlCellChangeApplied
constants.description: The value in the cell has been edited or recalculated, and that change has been applied to the data source. (Applies only PivotTable reports with OLAP data sources)
